_comment: Baseline error counts for opt-in strict flags NOT yet enabled in tsconfig.app.json. scripts/check-strict-baseline.mjs fails CI if a flag's count INCREASES vs this file (regression guard) and auto-promotes to 'must be 0' once the baseline hits 0 (so the next PR can simply move the flag into tsconfig.app.json without touching CI). Update by running: node scripts/check-strict-baseline.mjs --update. Flags already enabled in tsconfig.app.json must be REMOVED from this file (they are enforced by the normal typecheck job).
